name: Queensland Symphony Orchestra $35 student tickets
summary: $35 tickets to QSO concerts at QPAC Concert Hall and QSO Studio for full-time tertiary students who join the student list.
key: $35 tickets are available for full-time, tertiary students.
who: Student card must show a clear expiry date.
how: Sign up to the QSO student list using the form on the page.
Book by phone to avoid the $7.20 online booking fee.
catches: B and C Reserve only, two tickets per transaction, until allocation is exhausted.
Not available at live movie events or featured events.
The page sits under a 2025 web address; confirm it still applies for the current season.

evidence.quote: $35 tickets are available for full-time, tertiary students.
Available at all QSO performances in the QPAC Concert Hall and the QSO Studio.
Available in B & C Reserve only
